svg.title: leemanh — Data Engineer
svg.desc: Japanese editorial GitHub profile, drawn entirely as SVG code.

g.text: I build scalable data systems that turn complexity
into clarity and raw data into decisions.
From raw events to trusted datasets
Production-ready lakehouse on AWS with Iceberg, Glue, and Trino.
Streaming platform with Kafka, Spark, and Hudi on AWS.
Reusable Airflow DAGs for batch & streaming workloads.
Useful Trino SQL templates & performance tuning.
I build things that outlast it.”
